title: My Lunchbox Started Talking
description: A story about the strangest lunch of my life.

characters.name: Me
characters.look: a kid with brown hair, a green t-shirt, grey shorts and red sneakers

scenes.narration: On Monday, my lunchbox started talking to me in the middle of class.
scenes.visual: me at my desk in a classroom

scenes.narration: At first I thought it was my friend in the next seat playing a joke.
scenes.visual: me looking at the desk next to me

scenes.narration: But then it said my name, and nobody else could hear it.
It told me not to eat the sandwich my brother made for me.
I asked why, and it just said trust me.
So at lunch, I gave the sandwich to the class hamster instead.
scenes.visual: me in the cafeteria with a hamster cage

scenes.narration: The hamster took one bite and fell asleep for three hours.
That is when I knew the lunchbox was telling the truth.
After school, I ran home to find out what was in that sandwich.
My brother was in the kitchen, laughing with his friends.
He had put his sleeping medicine in it so I would miss the big game.
scenes.visual: a pill bottle on the counter

scenes.narration: The game was tomorrow, and I was the only one who could stop the other team.
I decided not to say anything and played it cool all night.
The next morning, the lunchbox woke me up before my alarm.
scenes.visual: me in my bedroom at sunrise

scenes.narration: It said my brother had a second plan, and it was worse.
He had hidden my football boots somewhere in the house.
I searched every room, but they were gone.
scenes.visual: me in the living room, cushions everywhere

scenes.narration: Then the lunchbox told me to look in the one place he never goes.
scenes.visual: me looking at the washing machine

scenes.narration: The boots were inside the washing machine, still dry.
I made it to the game just in time and scored the winning goal.
scenes.visual: me scoring on the football field

scenes.narration: My brother was so shocked that he told everyone what he had done.
And the lunchbox has not said a single word since that day.
